notes: «أن أبا كثير، حدثه» names him by the «أن X حدثه» form (rule 5); the comma inside «أبي، عثمان» is the text's own punctuation
The Prophet's saying follows; the last link is Abu Hurayra

fixes.reason: HKG's route runs through Yahya b. Salih and Yazid b. Abd al-Rahman, names the text does not write; the text has Yahya b. Abi Kathir and Abu Kathir.

evidence.quote: أخبرنا الحجاج بن أبي، عثمان حدثني يحيى بن أبي كثير
